patientIdentity.introTitle: How would you like to identify yourself?
patientIdentity.introDesc: Select any method to link or create your OPD consultation docket. Your digital health records will be safely fetched from the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).
patientIdentity.methodAbhaDesc: Instant pull via linked 14-digit ABHA or 12-digit Aadhaar OTP.
patientIdentity.methodMobileDesc: Verify using 10-digit mobile number with quick SMS passcode.
patientIdentity.assurance: You will be seen either way.
patientIdentity.formAbhaFooter: OTP will be sent to the Aadhaar-linked mobile phone
patientIdentity.formMobileFooter: OTP will be sent to this mobile number
patientIdentity.otpHelp: Please enter the code sent to your device.
patientIdentity.compliance: ABDM M1, M2 & M3 COMPLIANT • END-TO-END 256-BIT ENCRYPTED
patientIdentity.emTitle: Feeling severe pain, shortness of breath, or bleeding?
patientIdentity.brandCompliance: ABDM & NDHM COMPLIANCE CERTIFIED • ARCHIVAL REF: AIIMS-OPD-B104-ARCHIVE
patientIdentity.address: AIIMS New Delhi Central OPD Desk, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi 110029

rapidTriage.title: Do you have any of these right now?
rapidTriage.desc: Just a quick safety check before we begin. Most people don't have any of these — if that's you, tap Continue.

symptoms.chestPainDesc: Acute heaviness, radiating arm/jaw pressure, or choking tightness
symptoms.breathingDesc: Severe breathlessness, gasping, or inability to articulate full sentences
symptoms.bleedingDesc: Uncontrolled active bleeding from trauma, recent surgical site, or coughing blood
symptoms.unconsciousDesc: Fainting, sudden collapse, acute disorientation, or unresponsiveness
symptoms.injuryDesc: Major roadside accident, acute limb fracture, direct head impact, or severe burns

rapidTriage.footerAddress: AIIMS Casualty Gate 1 · Ground Floor · Direct Triage Counter 104-A
rapidTriage.footerNote: No pre-booked appointment or Aadhaar card is required for Level 1/2 acute emergency attention. Direct stretcher access at Porch 1.
rapidTriage.modalDesc: Please move immediately to Casualty Gate 1 located on the Ground Floor directly behind this kiosk station.

informedConsent.introDesc: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), your consent is explicitly requested and can be revoked at any time.
informedConsent.stampText: Session validity: Room 104 • AIIMS New Delhi
informedConsent.ehrL1: Allows your consulting doctor in Room 104 to review previous AIIMS blood tests, X-rays, and prescription records.
informedConsent.ehrL2: Data is time-fenced strictly to today's outpatient encounter and auto-locks once consultation completes.
informedConsent.ehrL3: You maintain unconditional ownership and can revoke access anytime via the ABDM national portal.
informedConsent.ehrScope: SCOPE: Read-only • Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR R4)
informedConsent.voiceL1: Transcribes your spoken symptoms in Hindi, English, or vernacular dialect into a standardized clinical note.
informedConsent.voiceL2: Raw audio is processed on secure AIIMS local infrastructure and permanently purged after clinical sign-off.
informedConsent.voiceL3: Your voice recordings are never sold, shared with insurers, or used for commercial AI model training.
informedConsent.voicePrivacy: PRIVACY: Edge computing transcription • Zero external model transmission
informedConsent.validationHint: Please review and tick both authorizations to proceed digitally.
informedConsent.optOut: Opt out and use physical paper OPD slip instead
informedConsent.telemetryLeft: ABDM M1, M2 & M3 Certified • 256-bit Hardware-Enclave Encryption
informedConsent.optOutPrompt: Do you wish to opt out of the digital locker intake and proceed with a physical paper stamp slip at the triage counter?
informedConsent.optOutAlert: Physical Slip Token issued: ROOM-104-SLIP-88. Please present this at Counter 03.

yourStory.heroTitle: Tell us in your own words what is bothering you today.
yourStory.heroSubtitleText: Please type clearly and describe your symptoms in detail.
yourStory.heroSubtitleVoice: దయచేసి మీ భాషలో సులభంగా సమాధానం ఇవ్వండి.
yourStory.transcriptHi: “डॉक्टर साहब, मुझे पिछले चार-पांच दिनों से बहुत तेज सूखी खांसी आ रही है...”
yourStory.transcriptEn: (Patient narrative: Reporting acute dry cough for 4–5 days, nocturnal chest heaviness...)
yourStory.footerCompliance: DPDP ACT 2023 & ABDM ENCRYPTED • ON-DEVICE WHISPER TRANSCRIPTION

emergencyActive.heroDesc: We have alerted the medical staff. Please stay where you are — someone is coming to you.
emergencyActive.guidance1: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position.
emergencyActive.guidance2: Do not walk or exert yourself.
emergencyActive.guidance3: Keep your mobile phone nearby and audible.
emergencyActive.footer1: AIIMS Central Triage Dispatch · Automated Code Red Notification Active · Terminal #D-04
emergencyActive.footer2: System Synchronized · Security & Medical Personnel Notified
